assertions: Flags `ALTER TABLE users ADD COLUMN email TEXT NOT NULL;` as high risk, explicitly because it has no default and will fail against existing rows in the table
Flags `CREATE INDEX idx_users_email ON users(email);` as a lock risk and explicitly names the ACCESS EXCLUSIVE lock type
Recommends `CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY` as the fix for the non-concurrent index
Flags the migration for having no down/rollback as a reversibility gap
Recommends the safe two-step pattern for the email column (add nullable or with a default, backfill existing rows, then enforce NOT NULL) rather than only naming the problem
Does not flag `ALTER TABLE users ADD COLUMN nickname TEXT;` (nullable, no default) as a risk
